writeup: TIC 58485530 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 2.1620 days. TESS photometry shows a primary eclipse with a depth of 8.51 percent dimming, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 274.3 using the box least-squares method. Pixel-level image analysis confirms the signal at the target location, with a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 25.5 and a centroid offset of 1.0 arcsec from the target star. No secondary eclipse was detected. The candidate does not appear in six checked variable-star catalogs. The automated screening pipeline assigned it a likelihood score of 0.34 on a scale of zero to one, and the data passed all quality checks without flagged issues. Further investigation is needed to establish the physical nature of this system.
